_compactTableRatchet: The compact one-line table is FROZEN (product-owner decision, 2026-08-30): no new row may join
that format, and the existing ones convert to detailed rows opportunistically. This number may
only ever DECREASE — check:debt-status fails if the table grows, AND fails if this number sits
above the measured count, so a conversion must be recorded here in the same commit.
It is NOT the 66 the spec stated. 66 was 42 compact rows plus the 24 rows of the Closed-numbers
ledger — a permanent record that only ever grows — so a ratchet of 66 would have permitted 24
new compact rows before it ever fired.
It is 43 rather than the 42 first measured, and the one-row difference is A7 working. The
register held a compact row whose number cell was PROSE (`**ADR-0031 toolbar fast-follows**`),
so it was uncountable, uncitable and invisible to the uniqueness check. Giving it the number 221
made it countable, the table went 42 -> 43, and the gate refused the stale ratchet in the same
commit that changed the count. That is the failure mode this field exists to catch, caught.
